_comment: QUESTION: At 2000 ms, does advisory depth buy placement, and what does 16.8 ms/decision cost the one-ply search that pays for it?
READS OUT: scoutThreads, scoutPlies, postContactPlies, scoutRefusals, worstWallMs, decisions, score

DESIGN NOTE: observe AND advise as separate arms: observe measures the cost with no behaviour change at all, so observe-vs-off isolates the tithe and advise-vs-observe isolates the advice. One arm carrying both would report their sum. Potion-bearing boards are REFUSED by the door under a potion-free premise and are counted as refusals — expect nonzero scoutRefusals on potion cells, and read it as the honest refusal it is.
FLAG-VALUE TRAP: every CL flag parses only `1`, `on` or `true`, with no
warning on anything else. Set the OFF arm by OMITTING the variable, and
check the manifest envAtRun block afterwards. Since the CL7 telemetry
closure the per-game rows also carry the RESOLVED flag stamp, which is
the value that actually ran — read that, not the environment.
